This is the FIRST bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant who has been arrested on 23.10.2022 in connection with Crime No.205/2022 registered at Police Station Sanchi,
District Raisen for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 376 (2) (n), 120-B of IPC and Section 5-L/6 of POCSO Act.

2. It is the submission of the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is suffering confinement since 23.10.2022 and charge-sheet has already been filed, therefore, chance of tampering with evidence/witnesses is remote.
It is further submitted that story indicates consensual nature of relationship prima-facie shared by the parties.

sentences.text: Applicant does not bear any criminal record.
Confinement amounts to pretrial detention.
Applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial.
He would not be a source of embarrassment or harassment to the prosecutrix and he would not move in the vicinity of prosecutrix.
Under these grounds, counsel prayed for bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for its dismissal.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5.
Considering the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
8. A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
